legend.review: none = high-confidence, no action needed · confirm = low-confidence or authored, needs ACCEPT/MODIFY/REJECT · open = genuinely undefined, reviewer may direct or leave open

decisions.decision: Primary action = solid Economist Red #E3120B rectangle with white label; secondary = 2px ink outline rectangle; tertiary = underlined text link. Labels sentence-case, sans, 14/500.
decisions.evidence: red block + white text observed (covers/logo contexts); no live buttons observable (site blocked)
decisions.reasoning: Red is punctuation; a solid red control is the strongest on-brand expression of a primary action without inventing shapes.
decisions.alternatives: ink-fill primary with red only as accent; underlined red text-actions

decisions.decision: Zero radius everywhere. Controls, cards, fields, dialogs are strict rectangles; the only shapes are rectangles, rules and glyph marks.
decisions.evidence: rectangle motif native to the identity; no radius ever mentioned; crisp-lines language
decisions.reasoning: The shape vocabulary is explicitly rectilinear across static and animated assets.
decisions.alternatives: hairline-radius softening (rejected: unevidenced and against the crisp register)

decisions.decision: Interaction transitions are near-instant (≤0.15s colour swaps); no bounce, spring or decorative movement in UI chrome. Motion stays native to brand assets, not interface controls.
decisions.evidence: motion is identity-native (animated rectangles) but UI timings are UNDEFINED
decisions.reasoning: 'Less is more' + restraint suggest crisp swaps; springs would contradict the register.

decisions.decision: Three registers by role: Serif = headlines and body text; Sans = navigation, metadata, datelines, captions; Sans Headline = display-only moments (page mastheads, big statics), used sparingly.
decisions.evidence: Marber typography roles, verbatim
decisions.reasoning: Directly documented roles.

decisions.decision: Screen rhythm: serif headline 30–34/1.15; standfirst sans? no — serif standfirst 16–17 muted; body serif 17/1.55; metadata sans 12.5–13 with 0.06em caps for section labels; display 44 at tracking −1.
decisions.evidence: cadence observed (headline + one-line dek); numeric scale UNDEFINED in sources
decisions.reasoning: Plain editorial rhythm; values kept modest to avoid inventing a scale with false precision.
decisions.alternatives: larger display scale; all-sans metadata weight games

decisions.decision: Red #E3120B is punctuation: section labels, active nav underline, single solid blocks, emphasis rules, primary controls. Everything else is ink (#1A1A1A/#333), white, or the London grey ramp. City palettes stay in reserve (data/sections only; not core chrome).
decisions.evidence: Marber colour tokens; 'red thread' theme; red retained through refreshes
decisions.reasoning: Token-level evidence.
decisions.alternatives: red as large background fields (reserved for very few moments only)

decisions.decision: White ground; section separation via 2px ink rules, hairlines (London 85), and red-95/grey-95 canvas washes. No shadows, no elevation, no soft chrome.
decisions.evidence: crisp lines/typing cursors/search bars language; no shadow evidence anywhere
decisions.reasoning: The surface discipline is flat and ruled.

decisions.decision: The red thread appears as a hairline red rule device (headers/footers/section breaks) — a connective mark, never a border for content blocks. Rhythm glyphs (small black squares of graded size) may punctuate list ends or step markers.
decisions.evidence: red thread named as connective theme; glyphs 'reborn as a visual language' (rhythm, emphasis)
decisions.reasoning: Direct application of the two documented motifs to interface chrome, kept minimal.
decisions.alternatives: rule-only (no glyphs); glyphs in body copy (rejected)

decisions.decision: Section label (sans caps, red) → serif headline → one-line standfirst (muted serif). Repeats strictly; no decorative sub-heads.
decisions.evidence: homepage module pattern; standfirst cadence
decisions.reasoning: Recurring observed unit.

decisions.decision: Top bar: white, 2px ink bottom rule; wordless-brand zone left (name in serif), nav links sans 13/500, active = red underline; a crisp search rectangle with a static typing-cursor motif at the right.
decisions.evidence: nav + search bar + typing cursor all named in identity coverage; live layout unobservable
decisions.reasoning: Composes documented cues; search is a signature cue of the identity.

decisions.decision: Fields: white, 2px ink border, square, label above in sans caps 11; focus = 2px ink border plus a 1px offset outer ink line; error message set small in red beneath the field.
decisions.evidence: no form evidence; register derived
decisions.reasoning: Squared-off bureaucratic honesty; keeps red for emphasis only.
decisions.alternatives: red focus border; background tint on focus

decisions.decision: Small sets (≤ ~12) = native select squared like a field. Larger/filtered = out of scope; platform fallback, marked.
decisions.evidence: none captured
decisions.reasoning: Same honesty rule as elsewhere: no invented combobox.

decisions.decision: Status = rectangular ink-outline tag, word inside (uppercase sans 11, 0.06em). Attention states turn the tag solid red with white word. No pills, no dots as sole signal.
decisions.evidence: no status component observed; rectangle + caps languages observed
decisions.reasoning: Rectangular tags extend the geometry; red-for-attention matches red-as-punctuation.

decisions.decision: Notices = ruled boxes (2px ink top or left rule) with terse declarative copy; no toasts (none evidenced); problem copy names the fact and the next step.
decisions.evidence: no feedback observed; declarative voice observed
decisions.reasoning: Ruled box is the natural vessel of a ruled system.

decisions.decision: Destructive flows confirm in a square dialog: 2px ink frame, consequence sentence (terse, no euphemism), confirm = solid red rectangle labelled with the verb, cancel = outline rectangle. Destructive is never pre-focused.
decisions.evidence: no destructive pattern; register derived
decisions.reasoning: Seriousness via plain statement + solid red verb button.

decisions.decision: Progress = crisp rectangle track (London 85) with red fill; readout as sans metadata ('7 of 10 steps'); restart = outline rectangle. Static updates only.
decisions.evidence: no meter observed; rectangle/grey/red primitives attested
decisions.reasoning: Composes attested primitives; animation stays out of UI.

decisions.decision: Empty state = ruled statement block with one action (outline or red rectangle); no illustration.
decisions.evidence: no imagery needed per 'purposeful imagery' rule; register derived
decisions.reasoning: Imagery is purposeful; an empty list has no story to illustrate.

decisions.decision: Ledger = editorial table: 2px ink header rule over sans-caps labels, hairline row rules (London 85), serif names, sans numbers; row hover = red-95 wash; no zebra; right-aligned numeric column feel.
decisions.evidence: editorial rules + type registers; comparison-table structure implied by register
decisions.reasoning: Table as newspaper furniture: rules do the separating.

decisions.decision: Dialog = square white sheet with 2px ink frame; scrim = ink at 62%; instant appearance; no entrance motion.
decisions.evidence: no dialog studied; flat ruled language attested
decisions.reasoning: Consistent with flat surfaces + instant transitions (L-03).

decisions.decision: Terse, declarative, fact-forward; dry wit allowed in one clause, never exclamatory; headline + one-line standfirst cadence in UI copy too.
decisions.evidence: standfirst samples; 'sharp writing style' named as identity
decisions.reasoning: Quoted register.

decisions.decision: No imagery in the reference build. Blur→focus is a documented device but belongs to story layouts; absence here is honest, not a gap.
decisions.evidence: imagery described as purposeful/story-bound
decisions.reasoning: Scoped to what a data register needs.

decisions.decision: Single-column collapse; display scale steps down (44→34); table becomes stacked rows with sans labels; nav collapses to a text row. Minimal, honest.
decisions.evidence: no responsive evidence (live site blocked)
decisions.reasoning: Least-invention collapse.

decisions.decision: Focus ring = 2px red outline offset 2px on white; on red fills, switch to white inner + ink outer ring.
decisions.evidence: none captured
decisions.reasoning: Red punctuation makes focus legible; switch rule mirrors contrast logic.

decisions.decision: Never: rounded corners; soft shadows; pills; decorative colour; red as large background for reading content; invented hues; emoji; exclamation marks.
decisions.evidence: absences across all fetched material + stated 'less is more' principles
decisions.reasoning: Codifies what the system never does.
